findings.evidence: Current editor.splitRoom spreads the original room into the left result but creates the right room from id/label/boundary only. findings.risk: If those existing helpers merely accept the new field, splitting could omit a ceiling and merging could silently replace a different second-room height with the first-room height.

Never silently spread the first room's ceiling over the second room. Record this as a future F03 rule without writing infrastructure in F00/F01.
